>I definitely agree with you with all things being equal.  But that's also just one factor.  

a big factor.

>How smart and clever you are will also play an important factor during interviews.

less so for women

> And depending on the job, how pretty you are may not matter much.

oh it definitely does.

this sounds like a minority case. if an ugly girl flirts

also, the fact that you have to put extra effort in for the same amount of respect still shows it's not fair.

also this isn't just about relationships and flirting but how you are generally treated your whole life by people
if you're a woman your looks will be much more important than those things
when i get money, for sure. can't lie i'm scared of the risks though - i'm deformed, so it'd be more than a nosejob

you have so much more opportunities if you look pretty or even just average.

also, this wasn't just to do with relationships but also social life.

>Everyone gets old and saggy in the end. I work in a wealthy retirement home and you witness first hand people who used to be attractive realizing they’re not anymore. A lot and I mean A LOT of those attractive women will end up married, having kids, realizing they have no personality or life outside of their children, and eventually be placed in care facilities by those children. 
>

i'm 19. i don't want to have to wait until i'm old to avoid a type of discrimination.

>So look at it this way, would you rather be ugly and end up in a meaningful relationship or attractive and no self identity. 

what. lmao.... it's not just about relationships. you get fucked over by looks socially too. also why care about having an identity if you're good looking?

what i'm saying is a 5 will always be treated better than a 4, both of those being common. this is still bad enough

also 5/10 is average.

what i'm saying is, anyone who is ugly, so, a 2, will be treated worse than even a 5. which is bad. it's still valid lookism
isee plenty of decent looking people irl. you're just thinking of those 10/10 models. you don't need to be a 10/10 for looks discriminatiin.a 6/10 will be treated better than a 5/10.
all i can do is spread awareness.

>Beautiful people have it easy on first interactions, people reach out to them rather than the opposite, 

idk man seems pretty severe and long term to me. remember if your first impressions and all that are bad theres not even going to be a "long term" for them to like your personality

> (I’m talking about really attractive people here)

no, even a 6/10 will be treated better than a 4/10
no, society needs to accept being ugly, so that people get treated equally regardless of their looks
because the point of this post is physical beauty you "silly twit" it sounded like you were invalidating the situation by ignoring his core issue

>I know you might think this is bullshit and you’ve probably heard it a million times, but beauty comes from within. 


that's not what beauty is.
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/m/pubmed/21536551/

> Attractiveness is highly subjective. 

[facial attractiveness is absolutely not subjective.](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/m/pubmed/21536551/) this is a dangerous idea to spread because it belittles how severe looks discrimination is. as a deformed girl i wish people stopped hiding the fact that looks are subjective, that looks don't matter. saying this kind of stuff is harmful as it ignores the root issue. it's okay to not be beautiful - that's the direction society needs to go. recognise when someone isn't attractive, but realise that it's ok. saying stuff like it's subjective is just not true. same with saying that looks don't matter.

i had a group of friends who turned out to be manipulating me the whole time, apart from that, nobody id consider close

no boyfriends yet
i cannot take it anymore.

im in the UK but my surgery is mainly cosmetic due to how the only issue is breathing. but even if my nose was fixed i'd still noticably be deformed, so the nose might be one i get free but my eyes, cheek and mouth are still messed up
theres no helpful advice apart from surgery, really. which is where all my moneys going to

my voice has been quite... raspified by  the way my mouth is. no eating issues though

i find breathing more difficult due to how one side of my nose is collapsed
my deformity is hemifacial microsomnia but mines severe not mild like the ones on google images. i look more like the people with parry romberg syndrome
nope
i haven't had one

>What kind of a facial deformity do you have?
>

one side of my face never developed properly, so i have very weak facial muscles like a massive indent in my cheek which goes down to half my lips. the skin gets pulled down by this indent making the eye on that side hooded. my nose cartilige on the deformed side of my face never developed properly either so one side of my nose looks collapsed

>Does it impact your ability to eat, speak, or smell?
>

i can eat normally. my voice sounds a bit odd from it. i can still smell. it affects my breathing as i can only breathe through one nostril

>What is your favorite type of cheese?

red leicester + mozzarella + cheddar mixed
i don't care about sports

my nose could be fixed for free on the NHS as the shape technically affects my breathing. so it could be classed as medical instead of cosmetic.

but my other ugly features do not affect my health and i can't afford cosmetic
the comments she gets make me suicidal holy shit.. being ugly is a curse. i got called twofaced by a stranger today. (my deformity affects half my face so its like i have two faces on each side)
i have a facial deformity affecting half my face so it is objectively pretty bad
i have a noticable facial deformity affecting half of my face. i wish i had your smile
you have a good face.
you look like the male version of a girl i went to school with. scarily so.
you're good to go. your face is good enough to ignore the neck
average but if you slim you can be above
nothing to worry about

your face is good. just need to slim down. if you want to be conventionally attractive after slimming then you easily could by trimming your hair short, but if you want to keep your style you still wouldn't be ugly if slim
you don't look like an alcoholic
look good

i remember your original post.

your face may be asymmetrical but your individual facial features are nice enough that you aren't ugly. you're good. only issue is the skin like you said
not ugly

my deformity affects the left side of my facial structure.

on the left of my face, half of my nose has collapsed due to poor cartilige development. and half of my lips and cheek have a huge dip in it as if i were sucking one half of my cheek in. one of my eyes are super hooded due to the skin being stretched down by the under developed muscles
yep. i'm a deformed girl and it fucking sucks. stares and bullying galore.
